{{Top|leg}}
'''''"Fertility of the Soil, Challenge of the Sky"''''' was the theme of the high festival on [[Saheelindeel]] in the year [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]<ref name="THNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>. The fair was previously a time of fertility and harvest, but in an effort to propel itself into the age of modern technology, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] added elements of an airshow and industrial exhibits to the festivities. Vehicles, including many that were considered obsolete on more advanced worlds, were put on display, along with communications and [[Hologram/Legends|holo]] apparatuses. An exhibition game of [[Shockball/Legends|shock-ball]] took place, as well as trophies awarded to the best thematic float or exhibit.
